howto.name: Upload the base PDF
howto.text: The PDF that forms the background.

howto.name: Upload the overlay PDF
howto.text: A PDF whose pages will be layered on top of the base.

howto.name: Choose mode and download
howto.text: Overlay: foreground on top. Underlay: behind. Stamp: applied to every page repeatedly. Output: a merged PDF with the overlay rendered onto each base page.

faq.q: What's the difference between overlay and merge?
faq.a: Merge concatenates files page-by-page. Overlay composites pages on top of each other — useful for adding letterheads, watermarks-from-PDF, or repeating templates.

faq.q: Can I overlay only some pages?
faq.a: By default it applies cycle-wise: if the overlay has 3 pages and the base has 10, the overlay repeats. For one-time overlay, use a base + overlay of equal length.
Yes — PDF supports transparency and the overlay's alpha is honored. White rectangles still cover what's beneath; transparent regions show base content through.
